data.narrative: Customer conducted four transactions within 51 minutes, each deliberately below the $10,000 CTR threshold, totaling $39,499. Transactions included wires to high-risk jurisdictions (Dubai, Hong Kong), a cryptocurrency exchange (Tallinn), and ATM cash withdrawal (Miami). Initial alert triggered based on structuring pattern, rapid velocity, geographic dispersion, and high-risk MCC codes. However, graph analysis revealed no suspicious network connections, customer has low-risk profile, verified KYC documents, no external fraud database matches, and activity aligns with approved trade settlement pattern (PAT-BENIGN-0099) for import/export businesses. Despite benign explanation, transaction pattern meets regulatory definition of potential structuring. SAR filed per BSA/AML requirements with note of exculpatory evidence.
